title: Zesty Smoky French Oats Salad
description: A bitter, crunchy and indulgent French salad that blends toasted oats with smoky salmon and roasted tomatoes for a pescatarian-friendly lunch.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and spread cherry tomatoes on a sheet pan.
Toast rolled oats in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Roast the cherry tomatoes in the oven until blistered, about 10 minutes.
Whisk together olive oil, Dijon mustard, lemon zest, salt, and pepper to create a vinaigrette.
In a large bowl, combine toasted oats, roasted tomatoes, and the vinaigrette, tossing until evenly coated.
Fold in smoked salmon strips gently, allowing the heat from the oats to warm the fish slightly.
Sprinkle chopped parsley and chives over the salad for freshness and color.
Serve immediately while the oats remain crunchy and the salmon stays moist.
Enjoy the zesty, smoky, and indulgent flavors of this French-inspired oat salad.
